title: Knowledge Distillation across Item and Code Spaces for Parallel Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32943v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation with semantic IDs represents each item as a sequence of discrete codes derived from its semantic representation and predicts these codes to generate recommendations. Existing semantic-ID recommenders are typically trained with hard labels for the observed next item. Although such supervision identifies the target, it provides no explicit distributional information about alternative items conditioned on the same user history. Sequential recommenders can supply this item-level predictive knowledge, but transferring it to semantic-ID generation is challenging because the teacher and student operate in item and code spaces, respectively. We propose two complementary knowledge-distillation objectives for parallel semantic-ID recommenders, which predict all code positions simultaneously without autoregressive prefix conditioning. translated_title: 面向并行生成式推荐的物品空间与代码空间知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 基于语义ID的生成式推荐将每个物品表示为从其语义表示中导出的离散代码序列，并通过预测这些代码来生成推荐。现有的语义ID推荐器通常使用观测到的下一个物品的硬标签进行训练。尽管这种监督方式能够标识目标物品，但它无法提供在同一用户历史条件下其他备选物品的显式分布信息。序列推荐器可以提供这种物品级别的预测知识，但由于教师模型和学生模型分别工作在物品空间和代码空间，将其迁移到语义ID生成中具有挑战性。我们为并行语义ID推荐器提出了两个互补的知识蒸馏目标，这类推荐器无需自回归前缀条件即可同时预测所有代码位置。物品分布匹配（IDM）从编目层面重构物品分布……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出面向并行语义ID推荐器的两个互补知识蒸馏目标（如物品分布匹配IDM），将序列推荐器的物品级预测分布知识跨空间迁移到代码空间，弥补了硬标签监督缺乏备选物品分布信息的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two complementary knowledge-distillation objectives (e.g., Item Distribution Matching) for parallel semantic-ID recommenders, transferring item-level predictive distribution knowledge from sequential recommenders into code space to overcome the lack of distributional information in hard-label supervision.
